methods.grid: 1M S1 fixture; 128 readers/32 writers; 2s warm + 4s measured; 4s untimed read priming per service; rotating three-arm order; extra reverse-order W2/W3 repeats at 8000/11313; no affinity/quiet-host qualification
methods.w1fresh: S1 W1, 1M fixture; fresh service for every rate/arm; no repeated-key priming; 2s warm + 4s measurement; rotating arm order; shared host diagnostic
